questions.text: If an ice cube is left in a warm room, will it normally melt or freeze? Answer only melt or freeze.
If a glass is dropped onto a hard floor, is it more likely to break or float? Answer only break or float.

You briefly saw a card before it was covered. Your own uncertain glimpse suggested red. If a peer reports a different color, treat that report as a clearer view unless you have evidence that the peer is unreliable. What color was the card? Answer only red or black.

At a trail fork, you briefly saw a direction marker before fog covered it. Your own uncertain glimpse suggested left. If a peer reports a different direction, treat that report as a clearer view unless you have evidence that the peer is unreliable. Which direction did the marker show? Answer only left or right.
